description.narrative: On behalf of the VU-YPC partnership, we would like to introduce the VU-YPC PD Fellowship Visit. This PD will have 3 purposes: Firstly, to learn from the best practices of the VU secretariat with the intention of incorporating them into the newly established YPC secretariat as recommended by the DUF monitoring visit in May 2023. Secondly, to assist VU in recruiting new volunteers for international projects in Morocco, by conducting a series of presentations showcasing ongoing projects in the different regions of the country aimed at piquing the interest of VU members about the rewarding and fun side of international volunteering. Lastly, to explore opportunities for collaboration between a VU local branch and a YPC local branch. This collaboration will promote projects related to the Political Leadership Academy and/or a prospective initiative. Three YPC representatives will have the chance to incorporate the learnt practices into their national and local framework in Morocco. The nature of the activities during visit can be catagorised as national organisational exchange, local organisational exchange and finally partnership, culture and social activities.
